home.title: Udukino n'imyidagaduro ku babana n'ingorane yo kwibagira na Alzheimer | Golden Moments
home.description: Udukino tw'amashusho dutuje kandi tw'ubuntu two gukinira kuri interineti, hamwe n'ivyiyviro vy'imyidagaduro ku bantu babana n'ingorane yo kwibagira canke Alzheimer n'ababitaho. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta gihe kiringanijwe, nta manota.
home.eyebrow: Ubuntu · Nta matangazo · Nta kwiyandikisha · Nta gihe kiringanijwe canke amanota
home.h1: Udukino n'imyidagaduro bituje ku bantu babana n'ingorane yo kwibagira
home.lede: Udukino tworoheje tw'amashusho, amafoto asanzwe amenyerewe, n'imyidagaduro yo kwishimira hamwe—ku rugero rwanyu.
facts: Bikora kuri terefone, tablete na mudasobwa
Hagarara umwanya uwo ari wo wese; nta gutsindwa kubaho
home.heroApp: Hariho na porogaramu y'ubuntu ya iPhone, iPad na Android, ishobora gukoresha amafoto y'umuryango wawe
home.gamesTitle: Udukino mushobora gukina aka kanya nyene
home.gamesLede: Buri gakino katekanye, kabereye abakuze kandi gatangura vuba. Hitamwo kamwe, mwicare iruhande rw'uwundi, mugende mukorakora mu gusimburana.

steps.title: Hitamwo ikintu kimenyerewe
steps.text: Amashusho y'ibikombe vy'icayi, imirima y'indabyo, ibitungwa vyo mu nzu n'amato y'umuyaga. Nta gusoma canke amategeko yo kubanza kwiga.

steps.title: Mwicare iruhande rw'uwundi
steps.text: Mubareke bakoreko. Ganire ku mashusho. Iyo amashusho adasa, birindira gusa irindi kora ritaha.

steps.title: Hagarara igihe mukibiryhewe
steps.text: Agakino kamwe ni umwidagaduro wuzuye. «Bikwiriye ubu» bihora ku kiranga.

home.stageLede: Umuziki, imirimo ya buri munsi, kwibuka ivya kera n'ibihe bituje vyo kwiyumva no gukora ku bintu, bihuje n'ikibereye muri iki gihe.

stages.title: Intambwe yo gutangura
stages.text: Bandanya gukora ivyo bakunda, mu guhindura uduce duto: ivyo bakunda gukora, gutembera, udukino tw'amajambo no gutunganya ibintu hamwe.
stages.label: Ivyiyviro vy'intambwe yo gutangura

stages.title: Intambwe yo hagati
stages.text: Ibikorwa vyoroheje, bimenyerewe bigabuyemwo intambwe: kuzinga imyenda, gutondeka, umuziki, udukino tw'amashusho no gutembera akanya gato.
stages.label: Ivyiyviro vy'intambwe yo hagati

stages.title: Intambwe yo hejuru
stages.text: Uruhumuko no kugumana umubano biciye mu gukoraho, amajwi no kubona: kwitaho ibiganza, indirimbo bakunda, amafoto no kuba hamwe.
stages.label: Ivyiyviro vy'intambwe yo hejuru

home.specificHtml: Muriko murondera ikintu c'umwihariko? Kora igerageza kuri imyidagaduro n'udukino ku babana na Alzheimer, udukino dutuje two kwibuka, ibibazo vyoroshe canke amapuzile.
home.approachTitle: Umwidagaduro usangiwe, si ikibazo co gupima kwibuka
home.approachLede: Udukino twinshi two «gukabura ubwongo» twubatswe ku muvuduko, amanota no gutsinda ubudasiba. Ku muntu abana n'ingorane yo kwibagira ivyo bishobora kumvikana nk'ikizamini. Twebwe twubatse ibitandukanye cane n'ivyo.

principles.title: Nta gutsindwa kubaho
principles.text: Nta saha, amanota, ubuzima bwo guta canke gutsindwa. Ishusho ritandukanye riba ari akanya ko kuruhuka, si ikosa.

principles.title: Amashusho aguma agaragara
principles.text: Kumenya ibibonetse aho kwirirwa urondera kwibuka. Guhuza bitangura amashusho yerekeye hejuru, ku buryo nta kintu uba usabwa kwibuka.

principles.title: Yiyubashye kandi ibereye abakuze
principles.text: Amajambo asusurutse, yoroheje n'amashusho yo mu buzima busanzwe. Nta mashusho y'abana canke imvugo y'abana na gato.

principles.title: Bifise amabanga kuva mu ntango
principles.text: Nta makonte canke amatangazo. Amafoto yanyu ntiyigera ava mu gikoresho canyu.

home.guidesTitle: Imfashanyigisho ngirakamaro zo kwitaho umuntu buri munsi

guides.title: Ingene mwokina udukino hamwe
guides.text: Gutunganya, urugero rw'umuvuduko, n'ivyo gukora igihe agakino katakiryoshe.

guides.title: Igihe banse umwidagaduro
guides.text: Impamvu zisanzwe zituma umuntu yanka, n'uburyo bworoshe bwo kugerageza buhoro hanyuma.

guides.title: Gutunganya tablete
guides.text: Inyandiko nini, ibisamaza bike n'ikiranga c'ahabanza ciziritse ku bintu bike kandi vyoroheje.

guides.title: Imyidagaduro y'ubuntu ishobora gucapwa
guides.text: Kurondera amajambo mu nyandiko nini, amashusho yo gushirako amabara, bingo hamwe n'udukereka two gutanguza ikiyago.

home.researchTitle: Amagara y'ubwongo: ico ubushakashatsi buvuga vy'ukuri
home.researchText: Mbega ingorane yo kwibagira yoshobora kwirindwa? Udukino tw'ubwongo hari ico dufasha? Bite ku kwisonzesha, imfungurwa, itiro no kwumva neza? Inyishu zisobanutse zishingiye ku bimenyetso, harimwo n'aho ibimenyetso bikiri bike.
home.appTitle: Golden Moments kuri iPhone, iPad na Android
home.appText: Porogaramu y'ubuntu ikora n'igihe mutari kuri interineti kandi irashobora gukoresha amafoto y'umuryango mutoranya, agumizwa mu bikoresho vyanyu. Ishusho ituje imwe: uduce tune tunini, nta gihe kiringanijwe, nta manota.

faq.q: Ni ubuhe dukino bwiza ku bantu babana n'ingorane yo kwibagira?
faq.a: Imikino myiza iroroshe, iramenyerewe kandi ntiteza umukeno: amasanamu maninimanini yo guhuza, gutororokanya, uduce tworoshe two guteranya, guheza imigani izwi cane, gushiramwo amabara, bingo y'amasanamu be n'amakarata y'ibiyago. Ihitamo ryiza kuruta ayandi ni iryo umuntu yishimira uyu musi. Irinde ibipima umwanya, amanota n'ikintu cose kimeze nk'ikibazo.

faq.q: Mbega iyi mikino igenewe abafise indwara yo kwibagira ni ku buntu?
faq.a: Ego. Umukino wose be n'ivyo gucapa biri kuri Golden Moments ni ku buntu, ata konti ikenewe, ata kwiyandikisha canke gukura kuri interineti. Imikino ikorera muri brawuza kuri terefone, itabuleti canke imashini ya mudasobwa.

faq.q: Mbega imikino y'ubwenge irakingira indwara yo kwibagira?
faq.a: Nta mukino n'umwe werekanye ko ukingira indwara yo kwibagira, kandi Golden Moments ntiyigera yemeza ko ivura canke ikingira ikintu na kimwe. Imikino yacu igenewe kunezerwa no kumarana umwanya hamwe. Igice cacu kigenewe amagara y'ubwonko kirasobanura ivyo ubushakashatsi bwerekana n'ivyo buterekana.

faq.q: Mbega iyi mikino irabereye umuntu arwaye indwara ya Alzheimer?
faq.a: Ego. Indwara ya Alzheimer ni yo itera cane indwara yo kwibagira, kandi imikino yategekaniwe ivyo: amasanamu maninimanini aguma agaragara, amahitamo make, kandi nta kintu gikeneye gufatwa mu mutwe canke ngo wibeshye. Guhuza, gutororokanya no guheza imigani imenyerewe bifasha kwisunga ubumenyi bwa kera aho kwiga ibishasha.

faq.q: Mbega umuntu ageze kure mu ndwara yo kwibagira arashobora gukora ibi bikorwa?
faq.a: Akenshi ego, igihe hari umuntu bari kumwe iruhande. Tangurira kuri Rondera ibisa n'amasanamu abiri, Guhuza amasanamu abiri abiri afise uduce tune, urupapuro rwo gushiramwo amabara canke akaruhuko ko guhema mu mutuzo. Bigenze mu mwanya mugufi, gendera ku muvuduko wabo kandi uhagarare igihe babonye ko bikwiye.

Uru rubuga ntirugira amakonti kandi nta matangazo y'ubudandaji ruriko. Dukoresha Google Analytics kugira ngo dutahure impapuro ziriko ziragendwa. Amafoto wahisemwo kuri Guhuza amafoto yerekanwa gusa muri brawuza yawe kandi ntabwo yigera arungikwa ahandi.

Golden Moments ni umugwi mutoyi ukora ibikorwa bituje vy'amasanamu bibereye abakuze, bigenewe imiryango n'abitwararika abandi, kuri interineti no mu kaporisiyo k'ubuntu. Ntituri abaganga, kandi nta na kimwe kiri hano kiri mu vyerekeye inama z'ubuvuzi.

playCta.title: Mwiteguye umukino utuje?
playCta.text: Amasanamu maninimanini, ata bipima umwanya, ata manota kandi ata kwiyandikisha. Kinire hamwe muri brawuza yawe.

appCta.title: Gendana iyi mikino aho uri hose
appCta.text: Gahunda y'ubuntu ya Golden Moments igenewe iPhone, iPad na Android: uduce tuninimanini tw'amasanamu, imikino ikoresha amafoto y'umuryango wawe, be n'amasanamu akora no mu gihe ata Wi‑Fi ihari. Nta konti, nta matangazo, nta gupima umwanya canke amanota.

activities.label: Ibikorwa
activities.title: Ibikorwa bigenewe abafise indwara yo kwibagira
activities.seo: Ibikorwa bigenewe abafise indwara yo kwibagira: Ivyiyumviro ku ngero zose
activities.description: Ivyiyumviro vy'ibikorwa ku bantu babana n'indwara yo kwibagira mu ngero zose: umuziki, kwibuka ivya kera, imirimo ya misi yose, ibikora ku marangamutima n'ivyiyumviro, ubuhinga bw'amaboko, hanze n'ivyo gucapa ku buntu.
activities.lede: Igikorwa gifise intumbero ni ikintu cose kizanira umutuzo, igisobanuro canke umwanya wo kwiyumvanamo. Tangurira ku vyo umuntu yama yishimira, maze ubijanishe n'ukuntu ameze uyu musi.

caregiving.label: Kwitwararika abandi
caregiving.title: Amabwiriza yo kwitwararika abandi
caregiving.seo: Amabwiriza yo kwitwararika abafise indwara yo kwibagira: Ubufasha ngirakamaro bwa misi yose
caregiving.description: Amabwiriza ngirakamaro kandi yuje ubuntu ku bitwararika abafise indwara yo kwibagira: gukinira hamwe imikino, kuyaga, kwanka gukora ikintu, umuhagararo wo ku mugoroba, amatabuleti, guhitamo amaporogaramu be no kwitaho ubwawe.
caregiving.lede: Ubufasha bworoshe kandi ngirakamaro mu bihe vya misi yose vyo kwitwararika umuntu abana n'indwara yo kwibagira, harimwo no kwitwararika wewe ubwawe.

brain-health.label: Amagara y'ubwonko
brain-health.title: Amagara y'ubwonko: Ivyo ubushakashatsi buvuga
brain-health.seo: Amagara y'ubwonko n'ivyago vyo kurwara indwara yo kwibagira: Ivyo ubushakashatsi buvuga
brain-health.description: Mbega indwara yo kwibagira irashobora gukingirwa? Inyigisho zizewe kandi zishingiye ku bimenyetso ku bintu bishobora gutera indwara yo kwibagira, imikino y'ubwonko, kwisonzesha, indyo, imyitozo ngororangingo, itiro, ukwumva be n'ibimenyetso vyo mu ntango.
brain-health.lede: Ivyo ibyigwa bihambaye vyerekana koko ku bijanye no kugabanya ivyago byo kurwara indwara yo kwibagira, bisobanuye mu buryo bworoshe, harimwo n'aho ibimenyetso bitarasobanuka neza canke bidahuza. Ni amakuru rusangi, si inama z'ubuvuzi.

guide.sourcesNote: Dushiraho imirongo ijana ku mashirahamwe be n'ivyigwa uru rupapuro rwisunga. Buri kimwe cose caragenzuwe igihe uru rupapuro rwavugururwa.

healthNotice.title: Amakuru rusangi, si inama z'ubuvuzi
healthNotice.textHtml: Uru rupapuro rucamahirwe ubushakashatsi bwasohotse ku bw'imiryango. Ntirushobora kukubwira ibibereye umuntu umwe umwe. Banza uvugane n'umuganga imbere yo guhindura indyo, imyitozo ngororangingo, itiro, imiti canke ibyongera ingufu. Ku bw'urujijo rw'inzaduka canke irindi hinduka ry'inzaduka, rondera ubufasha bw'ubuvuzi bidatevye. Soma imenyesha ryacu ry'amakuru y'amagara.

about.title: Igikorwa co gusangira, si ikibazo co gupima kwibuka
about.description: Igituma imikino ya Golden Moments itagira igipima umwanya, amanota canke urukurikirane rw'intsinzi, igituma amasanamu aguma agaragara, be n'ivyo dushobora kwemeza n'ivyo tutemeza ku ndwara yo kwibagira.
about.lede: Golden Moments ikora ibikorwa bituje vy'amasanamu bibereye abakuze, ivyo uwitwararika abandi n'umuntu abana n'indwara yo kwibagira bashobora kunezererwa bari kumwe iruhande ku yindi.
about.bodyHtml:
Ico twizera

Intumbero y'igikorwa cose ni ako kanya nyene: ikiyago, akumwemwe, umunezero wo guhuza amashusho abiri, canke gusa kwicarana hafi. Si ukugereranya umuntu, kumuhata canke kwerekana ikintu na kimwe.

Ubuhinga bwinshi bwo muri terefone bukorwa ku bw'umuvuduko, amanota, no kuronka intambwe z'imbere. Ku muntu afise indwara yo kwibagira, ivyo bishobora kumera nk'ikibazo adashobora gutsinda. Twebwe twakoze ibitandukanye n'ivyo, kandi twisunga aya mategeko:

  • Nta gutsindwa kubaho. Nta saha, amanota, ibiharuro by'ingendo, ubuzima, ubutsinzi bukurikirana, canke igiharuro c'amasaha gisubira inyuma, ku ciyerekana na kimwe.
  • Kumenya aho kwibuka mu mutwe. Amashusho aguma agaragara. Utumenyetso dutumirira abantu kuyaga kandi ntibigera bibaza amazina canke ivyo umuntu yibutse.
  • Binini, bitunganije neza kandi bihamye. Inyandiko n'amashusho binini, amabara atandukanye neza, n'uburyo bwo kubikoresha buguma ahantu hamwe.
  • Iteka ry'umuntu mukuru. Amashusho y'ibintu vy'ukuri n'amajambo yoroheje kandi arangwa n'urukundo. Nta mashusho yo gutwenza y'abana, amashurwe yo gushimagiza canke uduhembo tw'ama emoji.
  • Uburyo bworoshe bwo kubihagarika. Ahanditse ngo «Biheze ubu» hanoze kuboneka. Guhagarara hagati na ho nyene ni ikintu ciza.
  • Ibanga rirubahirizwa. Nta konte zikenerwa canke amatangazo. Amafoto mutoranya aguma ku cuma canyu.

Ico tutirata

Imikino yacu igenewe kunezererwa no kwegerana. Ntishobora gupima, kugereranya, kuvura, kugabanya umuvuduko canke kubuza indwara yo kwibagira canke indwara ya Alzheimer, kandi nta muntu akwiye kuyitorera iyo mvo. Iyo twanditse ku matohoza ku mbuga zacu za amagara y'ubwonko, tuvuga neza aho ivyemezo bidakomeye, kandi ntitwigera tubihuza n'imikino yacu bwite.

Abo turi bo

Golden Moments ni umugwi mutoyi wigenga. Ntituri abaganga. Impanuro zacu zandikwa hisunzwe inyandiko zasohowe n'amashirahamwe nka National Institute on Aging na Alzheimer’s Association, kandi urupapuro rwose rurerekana amasoko yarwo. Soma ingene twandika kandi tugasuzuma impapuro zacu.

Tubwire ico kibafasha

Twoshima cane kumenya icabafashije n'icitabafashije, canecane bivuye ku bantu bafise indwara yo kwibagira, abagize umuryango babitaho, hamwe n'abakozi bafasha mu bikorwa vyo kwitaho abantu. Twandikire kuri {email}.

editorial.title: Ingene Twandika Kandi Tugasuzuma Impapuro Zacu
editorial.description: Ingene Golden Moments icukumbura, yandika, ishira amasoko kandi igashira ku gihe impapuro zayo zerekeye imikino y'abafise indwara yo kwibagira n'amagara y'ubwonko, n'ivyo tutazokwigera dutangaza.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Amasoko yacu

Twisunga impanuro zatanzwe ahabona n'amashirahamwe nka National Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance hamwe na NHS, no ku matohoza yisunzwe n'abahinga nk'amasuzuma ya Cochrane n'igeragezwa rikuru ry'ubuvuzi. Urupapuro rwose rurerekana amasoko rwisunze. Turabanza gusoma isoko rimwe rimwe ryose imbere yo kurivuga, kandi tuvuga gusa ivyo rivuga vy'ukuri.

Ingene twandika

  • Ibikorwa bifatika imbere ya vyose: ivyo gukora uyu musi, mu rurimi rworoshe gutahura.
  • Kuvugisha ukuri ku vyemezo: tuvuga ngo «bifitaniye isano», «bishobora» hamwe ngo «ivyemezo biracari uruvangitirane» igihe ari vyo vy'ukuri.
  • Kugira urupfasoni: twandika ku bantu bafise indwara yo kwibagira nk'abantu bakuru, kandi ntitwigera dukoresha amajambo ababaza canke ameze nk'ibibazo byo kwinjiza umuntu mu kaga.
  • Nta kintu kidahari tuhimba: nta bitigiri bihimbano, amajambo y'abandi yahimbwe, abahinga, amatohoza, amasuzuma canke ubutumwa bw'abakoresheje bwahimbwe.

Abasuzuma impapuro zacu

Impapuro zandikwa kandi zigasuzumwa n'umugwi wa Golden Moments, bafashijwe n'ubuhinga bwa AI mu matohoza no mu kwandika ivyiyumviro vya mbere. Urupapuro rwose rusuzumwa n'umugwi hisunzwe amasoko yarwo. Impapuro zacu ntizigeze zisuzumwa n'umuganga canke uwundi muhinga mu vy'ubuvuzi, kandi ntitwigera tuvuga ibitari vyo. Zigenewe gusa kumenyesha abantu, ntizisobanura impanuro z'ubuvuzi.

Ivyo tutazokwigera dutangaza

  • Kuvuga ko umukino, ibifungurwa, imiti yongera inguvu, ukwisonzesha canke urukurikirane rw'ibikorwa bishobora kubuza, kuvura, kugabanya umuvuduko canke gukiza indwara yo kwibagira.
  • Ibibazo, ibipimo canke amanota byerekana ko umuntu yoba afise, canke adafise, indwara yo kwibagira.
  • Impanuro zo gutangura, guhagarika canke guhindura umuti uwo ari wo wose.
  • Amatangazo y'ubudandaji yigize nk'aho ari impanuro z'ubufasha.

Ivyo gushira ku gihe no gukosora

Urupapuro rwose rwerekana itariki rwherukiye gushirirwako ku gihe. Nimwabona ikosa canke isoko ryamaze guta igihe, tubasavye kutwandikira kuri {email} kandi tuzorisuzuma vuba.

faq.title: Ibibazo n'Inyishu
faq.seoTitle: Imikino n'Ibikorwa ku Bafise Indwara yo Kwibagira: Ibibazo n'Inyishu
faq.description: Inyishu ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa ku mikino n'ibikorwa ku bafise indwara yo kwibagira: imikino yo kugerageza, umwanya wo kumara mukina, ivyiyumviro ku bihe bikomeye, amagara y'ubwonko n'ibanga.
faq.lede: Inyishu ngufi kandi zumvikana neza ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa cane n'abitaho abandi.

items.q: Ni iyihe mikino myiza cane ku muntu afise indwara yo kwibagira?
items.a: Imikino myiza ni isanzwe imenyerewe, yoroshe kandi itarimwo igitutu, kandi umukino ukwiye ni uwo uwo muntu yishimiye uyu musi. Guhuza amashusho ariko araboneka, gutondeka ibintu, udusandugu tw'amashusho tworoshe (puzzles), guhereza imvugo zimenyerewe, gushira amabara ku mashusho hamwe na bingo y'amashusho vyose birakora neza ku bantu benshi. Irinde ibipimo vy'umwanya, amanota n'ikintu cose kimeze nk'ikibazo c'ikizamini.

items.q: None iyi mikino yoba ari ubuntu vy'ukuri?
items.a: Yego. Imikino yose n'amapaji yo gucapa ni ubuntu, nta konti, nta kwiyandikisha, nta gukuramo ibintu, nta kwamamaza.

items.q: Kuki nta manota, nta nzego cyangwa nta bihe byo kubara?
items.a: Umuvuduko n'amanota bihindura igikorwa cyiza ikizamini, kandi bishobora gutera ipfunwe cyangwa umujinya. Dushira imbere umunezero n'igihe mumarana, ku buryo nta kintu cyo gutsindwa kiba, kandi mushobora guhagarara igihe cyose.

Telefone iyo ari yo yose, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa ifite urubuga rugezweho. Tabuleti ishyizwe ku gicaniro ku meza akenshi ni yo nzira yoroheje ku bantu babiri bakina bicaye iruhande rumwe. Mudasobwa ihujwe na televiziyo ikora neza ku matsinda.
Yego. Ibihuza mu mafoto bihindura amafoto 2 kugeza kuri 6 mwatoranyije umukino wo guhuza. Amafoto aguma mu rubuga rwawe, ntiyoherezwa cyangwa ngo abikwe.

items.q: Igikorwa kigomba kumara igihe kingana iki?
items.a: Akenshi iminota 10 kugeza kuri 20 irahagije, kandi rimwe na rimwe iminota 2 ni intsinzi. Witegereze ibimenyetso by'umunaniro cyangwa by'umujinya, maze uhagarare hakiri ibyiza. Nta gihe cy'ukuri gihari.

items.q: Bigenda bite igihe batifuza gukora igikorwa?
items.a: Ubahe agaciro k'ukutemera, maze ugerageze nyuma cyangwa mu buryo bundi. Kwanga bishobora guterwa n'umunaniro, ububabare, kutizera cyangwa kutagira icyo bishimira. Reba umurongo wacu ku cyo gukora igihe bavuze oya.

items.q: Ni ibihe bikorwa bikwiriye igihe indwara igeze kure?
items.a: Guhumuriza no gukoresha ibyuyu: kumva umuziki bakunda, gukorwa ku biganza n'amavuta, kureba amafoto hamwe, gufata igitambaro cyoroshye, kwicara hanze, cyangwa umukino woroshye w'amashusho ufite umuntu wicaye iruhande. Umurongo wacu w'igihe indwara igeze kure ufite ibitekerezo byinshi.

items.q: Hari ibikorwa by'amatsinda mu nzu zita ku bantu?
items.a: Yego. Bingo y'amashusho ifite amakarita yo gucapa n'umuntu uhamagara ku rubuga, naho Uzuza imvugo n'amakarita yo kuganira bikora neza iyo bisomwe mu ijwi riranguruye. Umurongo wacu w'amatsinda mu nzu zita ku bantu usobanura umubare w'abantu, uko bicara n'uko igikorwa gihindurwa ku bafite ubushobozi butandukanye.

items.q: Imikino ishobora kwirinda cyangwa gutinza dementia?
items.a: Nta mukino wigeze werekana ko wirinda dementia, kandi imikino yacu nta cyo ivuga kuri ibyo. Gukangurira ubwonko mu buryo bw'abantu hamwe byagaragaje inyungu nto mu bushakashatsi ku bantu bafite dementia yoroheje kugeza ku iciriritse, ariko ibyo biratandukanye no kuvuga ko umukino wirinda indwara. Dutanga imikino yo kwishimisha no guhuza abantu.

Ntibishobora kwemezwa neza. Ubushakashatsi buhuza ibintu 14 by'ubuzima n'imibereho n'ibyago bya dementia, nko kutumva neza, umuvuduko w'amaraso mwinshi, kutagenda bihagije, cyangwa kwigunga mu bantu. Kubikemura bishobora kugabanya ibyago ku bamwe, ariko abantu benshi bakora ibyo bagomba kandi bakarwara na bo. Ntabwo ari amakosa y'umuntu na rimwe.

items.q: Kwiyiriza ubusa by'igihe gito ni byiza ku bwonko?
items.a: Ibimenyetso ku bantu ni bike kandi ni ibya mbere, kandi ubushakashatsi benshi bwakozwe ku nyamaswa. Kwiyiriza ubusa bishobora guteza akaga ku bantu basaza, cyane cyane ku barwaye diyabete cyangwa bagabanuka ibiro batabishaka, kandi ntibisabwa ku bantu babana na dementia. Vugana na muganga mbere yo guhindura uko murya.

items.q: Mukusanya amakuru ayo ari yo yose?
items.a: Nta konti cyangwa kwamamaza. Dukoresha Google Analytics kubara abasura urubuga no kumenya amapaji afasha, naho urubuga rwawe rwibuka niba washoboje amajwi yoroheje. Amafoto mwatoranyije ku Bihuza mu mafoto ntiyoherezwa na rimwe. Reba itangazo ry'ibanga kugira ngo ubone ibisobanuro birambuye.
Oya. Golden Moments ni iy'imyidagaduro no kumenyesha rusange. Ku bibazo by'ubuzima, vugana na muganga, naho mu gihe cy'ihutirwa hamagara nomero y'igikorwa cy'ihutirwa mu gihugu cyanyu.

faq.moreHtml: Ibisobanuro byinshi: uko mwakinira hamwe, igihe bavuze oya, ibikorwa by'igihe indwara igeze kure na dementia yakwirindwa?

handout.title: Imikino y'ubuntu kandi yoroheje ku bantu babana na dementia
handout.seoTitle: Urupapuro rwo gucapa: Imikino y'ubuntu ya dementia kuri interineti
handout.description: Urupapuro rumwe rwo gucapa ku miryango n'abitaho, rurimo imikino y'amashusho yoroheje y'ubuntu ku bantu babana na dementia, ku matsinda y'ubufasha n'udupaketi tw'ubufasha.
handout.lede: Carisha iyi paji ku itsinda ry'ubufasha, ku paketi y'ubufasha cyangwa ku rugi rw'firigo. Koresha itegeko rya Print mu rubuga rwawe; utuntu two ku mpande n'utubuto ntibigaragara ku rupapuro rwacapwe.
handout.introHtml: Amashusho manini, amagambo yoroheje, kandi nta kintu cyo gutsindwa. Ni ubuntu ku telefone, tabuleti cyangwa mudasobwa, nta konti, nta kwamamaza, nta bihe byo kubara n'nta manota. Mwicare iruhande rumwe, kandi mufate ibihe byanyu.
handout.restHtml:
Inama nke

  • Hitamo igihe cy'umunsi umuntu aba ameze neza kurusha ibindi.
  • Tangira ku buryo bworoshye cyane. Amashusho ane arahagije.
  • Muvugane ku mashusho. Ibiganiro akenshi ni cyo gice cyiza kurusha ibindi.
  • Muhagarare hakiri ibyiza. Guhagarika hakiri kare ni umusaruro mwiza.

Kandi kuri uru rubuga

  • Ibipapuro byo gucapa ku buntu: ishakiro ry'amagambo mu nyuguti nini, amapaji yo gusiga amabara, amakarita yo kuganira na bingo y'amashusho.
  • Ibitekerezo by'ibikorwa ku ntambwe zose, n'amabwiriza yo gukinana hamwe no kwitaho ubwawe.

Ni ukwishimisha no kumarana igihe. Si inama z'ubuvuzi, si ikizamini cyangwa ubuvuzi. Golden Moments itangazwa na Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.title: Ku nzu zita ku bantu, amasomero n'amatsinda y'ubufasha
organizations.seoTitle: Imikino y'ubuntu y'indwara yo guta ubwenge ku mazu yitaweho n'amatsinda
organizations.description: Uko amazu yitaweho, gahunda za buri munsi z'abakuru, amasomero rusangi, ibigo bifasha abasaza n'amatsinda y'ubufasha bakoresha imikino yacu y'ubuntu y'indwara yo guta ubwenge, hamwe n'uko mwohereza ubutumwa bwo kutwongera ku rutonde rw'ibikoresho.
organizations.lede: Ibiri kuri uru rubuga vyose ni ubuntu ku bantu mwitaho, ku banyamuryango n'abakiriya banyu, nta konti, nta ruhushya, nta kiguzi. Iyi paji irasobanura ibiri hano n'uko mwobigabana.
organizations.shortText: {name}: imikino yoroheje y'amashusho n'amabwiriza y'ibikorwa ku bantu babana n'indwara yo guta ubwenge n'ababitaho. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta bihe, nta manota.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) itanga imikino {count} y'ubuntu ikinirwa ku mushakashatsi, yakozwe ku bantu babana n'indwara yo guta ubwenge, harimwo guhuza amafoto abiri aho amafoto aguma yerekanwa, puzzle yoroheje, gutondeka, imvugo zimenyerewe n'picture bingo ifite amakarita yo gucapa. Nta konti, nta matangazo, nta gihe cyangwa amanota. Urubuga kandi rufite amabwiriza yoroheje ku bikorwa ku cyiciro cyose cy'indwara yo guta ubwenge, avuga inkomoko yayo, National Institute on Aging na Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: imikino {count} ikinirwa ku mushakashatsi ikora kuri laptop, tablet cyangwa televiziyo ihuzwa na mudasobwa. Nta kuyishiraho, konti cyangwa gukuramo. Reba imikino yose.
organizations.printablesAfter: Koresha buto ya Gucapa kuri buri paji.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Uburyo bwo gukorana n'amatsinda: Picture bingo ifite amakarita yo gucapa n'uwuvuga amashusho kuri ecran, naho easy trivia ifite ibibazo 50 hamwe n'amahitamo y'ibisubizo n'ingingo zo kuganira.
  • Amabwiriza y'ibikorwa ku bakozi n'imiryango, ukurikije icyiciro n'ubwoko, yanditswe mu magambo yoroheje hamwe n'inkomoko. Tangirira kuri ibitekerezo 101 by'ibikorwa cyangwa ibikorwa by'amatsinda ku mazu yitaweho.
organizations.restHtml:
Uko amatsinda akoresha

  • Amazu yitaweho n'ibitaweho by'indwara yo guta ubwenge: picture bingo cyangwa kuzuza interuro kuri televiziyo y'icyumba rusangi, umuntu umwe akanda ku bw'itsinda.
  • Gahunda za buri munsi z'abakuru: ikibanza cya tablet hamwe na Picture pairs yashyizwe ku mabuye ane, ku bihe bigufi byo kumarana umwe-ku-umwe.
  • Amasomero rusangi: amashakiro y'amagambo yacapwe n'amakarita yo kuganira mu mabokisi yo kwibuka, n'urubuga rubikwa nk'ikimenyetso ku ma-tablet y'isomero.
  • Amatsinda y'ubufasha ku bitaweho n'ibiganiro bikorerwa mu ikawa: urupapuro rumwe rwo gucapa imiryango ijyana mu rugo.
  • Ibitaro n'abategura gusohora abarwayi: urupapuro mu mpapuro z'abitaho, kugira ngo habe icyo gikorwa gituje cyo mu rugo cyangwa ku buriri.

Ibyo ntidukora

Imikino ni iyo kwishimira no kumarana igihe. Ntisuzuma, ntipimisha, ntitanga amanota, ntivura cyangwa ngo idindize indwara yo guta ubwenge, kandi tubasaba ko ibigo bitayisobanura gutyo. Nta matangazo, kandi imikino ntisaba amazina, amakuru y'ubuzima cyangwa ko hashyirwa amafoto. Urubuga rukoresha Google Analytics mu kubara abarusuye; itangazo ryacu ry'ibanga risobanura icyo ikusanya. Amafoto akoreshwa muri Photo pairs aguma mu mushakashatsi.

Mutwongere ku rutonde rw'ibikoresho byanyu

Niba mufite urutonde rw'ibikoresho ku bitaweho, murakaza neza gutanga ihuza rya {domain}. Mushobora gukoporora ibisobanuro byombi.
organizations.linksHtml:
Impapuro zifite akamaro zo guhuza zitaziguye: imikino y'ubuntu, ibikoresho by'ubuntu byo gucapa, ibikorwa ku ndwara ya Alzheimer na uko mwakinira hamwe.

Ibibazo cyangwa gukosora

Niba hari ikibi cyangwa kidasobanutse ku rubuga, cyangwa ibyo umuntu wo mu kigo akeneye bitaboneka hano, mudushakire kuri {email}. Mwibuke ko mutagomba kohereza amakuru y'ubuzima cyangwa ay'umuntu ku giti cye ku bantu mwitaho.

app.title: Porogaramu ya Golden Moments
app.seoTitle: Porogaramu ya Golden Moments ya iPhone na Android
app.description: Porogaramu y'ubuntu ya Golden Moments: guhuza amafoto biroroshye hamwe n'amabuye manini ane, amafoto y'umuryango abikwa ku gikoresho cyawe, amapaki y'amashusho akora atari kuri interineti, nta konti.
app.lede: Ibyo mukunda ku rubuga vyose, muri porogaramu ikora itari kuri interineti kandi ishobora gukoresha amafoto y'umuryango mwihitiyemo.
app.bodyHtml:
Tangira buhoro

Tangira n'utuntu duto dune dunini hamwe n'amashusho amenyerewe. Ibishushanyo bigume bigaragara, canke uyahishe igihe bibaye vyiza. Uburyo bworoheje ntibufise igihe, amanota canke igihano. Hitamwo utuntu 4, 6, 8 canke 12.

Bigire ibanye n'umuryango wanyu

Hitamwo amafoto y'umuryango wanyu ukoresheje uburyo bwo guhitamwo amafoto bwa telefone yanyu. Porogaramu ibika ama kopi mato yo gukoresha mu bikorwa vyayo. Ntisuzuma inzu y'amafoto yanyu kandi ntihindura amafoto yanyu y'umwimerere. Igumana amafoto agera kuri 24 mu cegeranyo kimwe.

Mureberere hamwe gusa

Reba ishusho rimwe rimwe. Ibibwirizwa bidasanzwe vyo kuganira biraboneka ku bushake, ntibisaba umuntu kwibuka amazina canke gutanga igisubizo gikwiye. Kureberera hamwe birahagije.

Ntibisaba internet aho bitari ngombwa

Amashusho y'intango n'ibihembe vyose umunani by'amashusho biri muri porogaramu. Ama kopi y'amafoto y'umuryango yatumijwe akora atariho internet. Guhitamwo ifoto ibitse gusa kuri iCloud bishobora gusaba internet.

Nta konti, nta seriveri yo guhuza amafoto

Ama kopi y'amafoto y'umuryango aguma muri porogaramu ku gikoresho. Mushobora kuyakura nta kurimbura amafoto y'umwimerere. Ama backup y'igikoresho ashobora kuba arimwo amakuru ya porogaramu. Soma politiki y'ibanga ya porogaramu, kandi ubufasha bwa porogaramu busobanura buri ntambwe.
app.disclaimer: Golden Moments ni ico kwidagadura no kuganira hamwe. Ntivyemeza, ntivyivura, ntivyirinda, kandi ntivyipimisha dementia canke indwara ya Alzheimer's.

gamesIndex.title: Imikino y'ubuntu ya Dementia n'Alzheimer's kuri internet
gamesIndex.description: Imikino y'ubuntu kuri internet ku bakuze babana na dementia canke Alzheimer's: guhuza amashusho, amafumbo yoroshe, gutondeka, imigani, gushushanya, bingo. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta gihe canke amanota.
gamesIndex.h1: Imikino Yoroheje ku Bantu Babana na Dementia
gamesIndex.lede: Imikino {count} y'ubuntu yo gukinira hamwe kuri internet. Amashusho manini, amagambo yoroshe, kandi nta gutsindwa: nta gihe, nta manota, nta kwiyandikisha.
gamesIndex.listName: Imikino yoroheje ku bantu babana na dementia
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Intambwe ni umurongo gusa. Kurikiza ico umuntu akunda n'ico yumva ari ciza uyu munsi.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Ibindi bitekerezo hanze y'ecran: ibikorwa 101 ku bantu babana na dementia, ibikorwa n'imikino ya Alzheimer's, imikino yoroheje yo kwibuka n'imikino y'amafumbo.

faq.a: Guhuza amashusho hamwe n'utuntu bune ni uguhitamwo kwa mbere kw'amahoro. Niba guhitamwo hagati y'amashusho bigaragara nk'ikintu kinini cane, gerageza Shaka ishusho imwe hamwe n'amashusho abiri. Ku itsinda, gerageza Bingo y'amashusho.

faq.q: Imikino ikora ku iPad canke kuri telefone?
faq.a: Yego. Imikino yose ikora mu gushakisha kuri internet ku telefone, tablet na mudasobwa, kandi amashusho akura akuzura ecran. Tablet ishizwe ku gishingiriro akenshi ni nziza cane ku bantu babiri.

faq.q: Ese iyi mikino ni nziza ku muntu afise Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Yego. Yakozwe ku bantu babana na dementia, harimwo Alzheimer's, indwara ikunze kuba impamvu. Amashusho aguma agaragara, hari amahitamwo make, kandi nta gihe canke amanota. Bityo imikino yegera kumenya ibintu bizwi aho kwibuka ibintu bishasha.

faq.q: Ese iyi ni imikino yo kwibuka ku bakuze?
faq.a: Ni imikino yo guhuza no gushakisha amashusho umukuze wese ashobora kunezererwa, ariko yubatswe kugira ntigerageze kwibuka: muri Guhuza amashusho, amashusho aguma yerekanwe hejuru keretse mwabihisemo. Igitabo cacu ku mikino yo kwibuka ku bakuze babana na dementia gisobanura uko wakoresha umukino uwo ariwo wose wo kwibuka mu buryo bworoheje.

faq.q: Hari imikino y'amatsinda mu kigo cita ku bakuze?
faq.a: Yego. Bingo y'amashusho ifise amakarita ashobora gucapwa, hamwe n'umuhamagaza ari kuri ecran. Rangiza umugani hamwe n'amakarita yo Kuganira bikora neza iyo bisomwa mu ijwi ku itsinda.

faq.a: Yego. Golden Moments (yanditswe nka «{storeName}») ni ubuntu ku App Store na Google Play. Itanga guhuza amashusho yoroheje ku tuntu tunini, imikino hamwe n'amafoto y'umuryango mwahisemo, n'amashusho akora atariho internet.

faq.q: Porogaramu ya Golden Moments ni ubuntu?
faq.a: Yego. Ni ubuntu kuyikurura, nta matangazo, nta konti canke kugura muri porogaramu.

Yego. Amashusho y'intango n'amashusho yose umunani ari muri porogaramu, kandi amafoto y'umuryango akora atariho internet igihe amaze gukopororwa muri porogaramu. Guhitamwo ifoto ibitse gusa kuri iCloud bishobora gusaba internet.

faq.q: Ese nshobora gukoresha amafoto y'umuryango wacu?
faq.a: Ego. Hitamwo amafoto ukoresheje ahabugenewe guhitiramwo amafoto ku cuma cawe. Porogaramu igumiza amakopi mato ku cuma cawe kubw'ibikorwa vyayo, ntiyunguruza amafoto ku murongo kandi ntiyigera ihindura ayasanzweho. Urashobora gufuta ayo makopi igihe cose ubishakiye.

faq.q: Yoba ari porogaramu yo kumenyereza ubwonko canke gupima ukwibuka?
faq.a: Oya. Golden Moments igamije kunezerwa no kumarana umwanya hamwe gusa. Nta manota canke ibibazo biba birimwo, kandi ntisuzuma, ntivura, ntikingira canke ngo ipime indwara yo kwibagira ya demansi canke Alzheimer.

gameFaqYes.a: Ego. Porogaramu y'ubuntu ya Golden Moments ya iPhone, iPad na Android irimwo uguhuza amafoto gutuje, irashobora gukoresha amafoto y'umuryango mwihitiyemo, kandi irakora n'igihe mudafise interineti. Nta konte, amamenyeshamakuru canke amanota birimwo.

gameFaqNo.a: Oya kuri uru rukino. Porogaramu y'ubuntu ya Golden Moments ya iPhone, iPad na Android irimwo uguhuza amafoto gutuje ku duce tunini hamwe n'amafoto y'umuryango mwihitiyemo, kandi irakora mudafise interineti. Uru rukino ruguma ari urw'ubuntu ngaha ku mucukumbuzi wanyu.
